leaving_soon.title: {count, plural, one {# title is} other {# titles are}} leaving soon
leaving_soon.body: Watch one and it stays. Nothing is removed automatically: they show as leaving for the next {grace_days} days, and every removal is started by hand.

test.title: Reaper is connected
test.body: This is a test message. If you can see it, your users will get a heads-up here before any title is removed.

recycle_bin.still_off_body: Reaper couldn't turn it back on after reap {run_id}. Turn it back on in Reaper, or in {name} under Settings → Media Management.
recycle_bin.back_on_body: Deleted files go to its recycle bin again.

dialog.crashed: Reaper stopped unexpectedly. Open it again to restart.
dialog.port_in_use: Reaper didn't start: port {port} is already in use, so this copy could not be reached at http://127.0.0.1:{port}. Quit whatever is using the port (another Reaper?) or {move}, then open Reaper again.
dialog.no_migrations: Reaper can't find its database migrations next to this install. Run the container, a packaged binary, the snap, or a source checkout instead.

move.conf: add a line like REAPER_PORT=8421 to {conf}
move.env: set REAPER_PORT to a free one
